# mtncloud_option_list (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud option list data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_option_list" "example_option_list" {
  name = "TF Example option list"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the option list
- `name` (String) The name of the option list
